rules: Drinking/stored water observations use water, never hydration or another synonym.
Categories classify proposals; they do not establish ownership, quantity, usability, functionality or an approved requirement.
Unsupported item categories use other and remain reviewable; no invented standard deficit.
Manual recorded supply requirements retain their existing explicit category identity and approved source/instruction requirements.
Native confirmation must preserve canonical category and units when accepting an observation into the host ledger.

For food, unit day must mean user-confirmed coverage for the entire household. Never infer household-days from cans, packages, weight, calories or a photograph. The current draft horizon is 3 days, not completion of the Red Cross 2-week home recommendation (S64).
